_scope: Helios is not ported yet, so the denominator is only the shared C++ core
that already compiles without a GL context.
Helios.cpp         the simulation still calls OpenGL directly
HeliosView.mm      AppKit/NSOpenGLView; needs a host process
As the port replaces those with testable code, move them into sources --
the ratchet will hold whatever coverage they arrive with.
Note the include style: this repo uses bare "rsMath.h", so each source
directory goes on the include path rather than just the repo root. This is
where helios and hyperspace differ -- hyperspace uses <rsMath/rsMath.h>.
OpenGL is linked because Implicit/impSurface.cpp calls it from draw() and
the destructor. Drop the framework once helios is ported, or once the
shared core is extracted and unified.
